title: So Good They Can't Ignore You
author: Cal Newport
gist: Passion is a poor starting point: you earn work you love by building rare career capital, then spending it on control and a mission.

title: Principles for Dealing with the Changing World Order
author: Ray Dalio
gist: Empires rise and fall in a Big Cycle of debt, internal conflict and external rivalry, and the American order looks late in that cycle.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
gist: Eurasia’s lead came from domesticable plants and animals and an east–west continent, not from innate superiority.

title: Apple in China
author: Patrick McGee
gist: Apple did not just assemble the iPhone in China. It trained a manufacturing system there, and then found it could not leave.

title: Pachinko
author: Min Jin Lee
gist: Four generations of a Korean family in Japan survive by work, silence and a gambling trade the country despises.

title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
gist: Doing well with money is a test of behaviour and time, not of how many formulas you know.

title: Good Economics for Hard Times
author: Abhijit V. Banerjee and Esther Duflo
gist: Banerjee and Duflo trade grand theories of migration, trade and growth for what the evidence will support.

title: The Trading Game
author: Gary Stevenson
gist: A working-class trader bets that inequality will keep rates low, then cannot walk away from the bonus.

title: Zero to One
author: Peter Thiel with Blake Masters
gist: Real progress is a new monopoly, not a harder fight in a market that already exists.

title: Hello World
author: Hannah Fry
gist: Trust an algorithm when it predicts better, and keep the human when the decision is a judgement about a person.

title: A Song of Ice and Fire
author: George R.R. Martin

title: Factfulness
author: Hans Rosling, with Ola Rosling and Anna Rosling Rönnlund

title: How to Avoid a Climate Disaster
author: Bill Gates
